name: Pruszków County (Poland)
description: Two horizontal stripes of yellow over red with a wider yellow, charged in the centre of the yellow with the county arms of Pruszków: a shield with a white eagle on red and an armoured knight on blue.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
